name: MvPolynomial.coeff_hasseDeriv
source:
theorem coeff_hasseDeriv (d e : σ →₀ ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (hasseDeriv d P).coeff e = (hasseCoeff d (e + d) : R) * P.coeff (e + d) := by
  classical
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial k a =>
    rw [hasseDeriv_monomial, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial]
    by_cases hk : k = e + d
    · simp [hk]
    by_cases hdk : d ≤ k
    · simp [hk, tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le hdk]
    · simp [hk, (hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff d k).2 hdk]
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq, mul_add]

what: The coefficient at exponent e of the d-th Hasse derivative is the coefficient at e+d times the associated multivariate binomial factor.
how: Polynomial additive induction reduces to hasseDeriv_monomial; the monomial case separates the exponent equality and coordinatewise bound, using hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff when the bound fails.
hypotheses: Any commutative coefficient semiring and arbitrary multi-indices; additive cancellation in natural multi-indices, not ring subtraction, handles exponent reconstruction.
